faqs.q: What is Corevia and how does it work?
faqs.a: Corevia is a frontend foundation with landing pages, app screens and a component library. Pick a demo, swap in your content and deploy.

faqs.q: How do I get started with Corevia?
faqs.a: Clone the repository, run npm install and npm run dev. Every page lives under src/app and pulls its content from typed config files.
Starter is free, Pro is $49/month and Enterprise is $199/month. Annual billing saves 10%.

faqs.q: Is there a free trial available?
faqs.a: Yes. Pro includes a 14-day trial with no credit card required.
The latest two versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari, on desktop and mobile.
Everything is plain React with Tailwind classes and CSS design tokens, so you can restyle or extend any component.

faqs.q: How do I reset my password?
faqs.a: Use the Forgot password page. We'll email a reset link that stays valid for 30 minutes.

faqs.q: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
faqs.a: Open Account settings, choose Security and follow the steps to pair an authenticator app.

faqs.q: How do I get API access?
faqs.a: Create a key in Developer settings. Keys can be scoped to development or production.

faqs.q: What are the API rate limits?
faqs.a: Starter allows 60 requests/minute, Pro 600 and Enterprise is custom.

faqs.q: How do I connect to Slack?
faqs.a: Add a webhook endpoint in Developer settings and paste your Slack incoming-webhook URL.
